journey.name: Hardware Wallet Send On-chain
journey.description: Drives the on-chain Send sheet from a paired Trezor: Recipient -> Amount -> Review -> Sign With Device -> Sent, then verifies the payment is listed once as an outgoing blue hardware activity and that the hardware balance dropped by at least the amount. Requires a paired Bridge emulator whose native-segwit account holds at least 50 000 confirmed regtest sats (fund the emulator's receive address with the regtest bitcoin node and mine a block), and a valid regtest destination address that does not belong to the emulator, for example a fresh address of the regtest node. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Note the sats amount shown on the hardware wallet tile (id "ActivityHardware") beneath the SAVINGS and SPENDING tiles
Tap the hardware wallet tile and verify the hardware wallet detail screen opens (id "HardwareWalletScreen")
Tap the Send button (id "Send") of the tab bar
If a camera permission dialog appears, dismiss it by choosing "Don't Allow"
Verify the Send sheet shows the recipient options, then tap "Enter Manually" (id "RecipientManual")
Type the destination regtest address into the recipient field (id "RecipientInput") and tap Continue (id "AddressContinue")
Verify the Send amount screen (id "SendAmount") is visible and its available amount (id "AvailableAmount") is greater than 0
Tap the keys "1", "0", "0", "0", "0" (ids "N1", "N0", "N0", "N0", "N0") to enter 10 000 sats and tap Continue (id "ContinueAmount")
Verify the review screen (id "SendConfirm") shows the destination address, an amount of 10 000 sats and a non-zero network fee, with a blue accent that marks the hardware wallet as the funding source
Verify the sign screen (id "HardwareSendSign") is titled "SIGN WITH DEVICE", shows the destination address under "To address (confirm on device)" and the amount (id prefix "HardwareSendSignAmount")
Approve each prompt on the Bridge emulator in order (recipient, amount, fee and summary) with the controller command that presses Yes
Verify the Sent screen (id "SendSuccess") appears and shows 10 000 sats
Tap "Close" (id "Close"), mine one regtest block, wait for the app to sync, and verify the app is back on the hardware wallet detail screen (id "HardwareWalletScreen")
Verify the activity list of the hardware wallet detail screen contains exactly one new blue sent row of 10 000 sats above the older rows
Navigate back to the wallet home screen and verify the hardware wallet tile shows a lower amount than the one noted at the start, by at least 10 000 sats
